_meta.description: Global functions REMOVED at each Elgg major version, with their replacement. Used by PostMigrationVerifier::checkRemovedFunctions() to flag calls to functions that no longer exist at the migration target (the 'undefined symbol' class the shape-based completeness gate is blind to — bd elgg-migrate-abyju). Each target version's set is treated cumulatively: a function removed at 4.x is still removed at 6.x.
_meta.method: Verified empirically via Elgg\Application::loadCore() + function_exists() inside the real core container (not static grep, which is fooled by plugin-provided functions). 6.x set verified against Elgg 6.1.5 on 2026-06-03.

false_positives_excluded.elgg_ws_expose_function: provided by the web_services bundled plugin — not a core removal
false_positives_excluded.elgg_view_input: provided by the forms_api plugin (mod/forms_api/functions.php) as a BC shim — calls work wherever forms_api is active; migrating to elgg_view_field() is optional modernization, not a fatal-fix, so it is NOT listed as removed
false_positives_excluded.elgg_get_total_comments: provided by the hypestash plugin (lib/functions.php) — delegates to hypeJunction\Stash\CommentsCounter; never an Elgg core/bundled global, so not a 7.x core removal
false_positives_excluded.elgg_get_total_likes: provided by the hypestash plugin (lib/functions.php) — delegates to hypeJunction\Stash\LikesCounter; never an Elgg core/bundled global
false_positives_excluded.elgg_get_total_friends: provided by the hypestash plugin (lib/functions.php) — delegates to hypeJunction\Stash\FriendsCounter; never an Elgg core/bundled global
false_positives_excluded.elgg_get_total_members: provided by the hypestash plugin (lib/functions.php) — delegates to hypeJunction\Stash\MembersCounter; never an Elgg core/bundled global

6.x.elgg_pop_breadcrumb: breadcrumbs auto-managed; remove or use elgg_set_breadcrumbs([])
6.x.elgg_group_gatekeeper: elgg_group_gatekeeper() removed — use elgg_entity_gatekeeper() / group access checks
6.x._elgg_get_access_where_sql: private API removed — use QueryBuilder access clauses

7.x.elgg_geocode_location: removed — no core replacement; needs a geocoding service (plugin-specific)
7.x.elgg_get_metastring_id: removed — internal metastrings API; rework via QueryBuilder/metadata API
